name: trapezoid_block
notes: A Paris block whose plan is a trapezoid 14 m wide at the front, 9 m wide at the back and 14 m deep, four storeys of pale stone under a slate mansard with dormers, shop arches and a doorway along the ground floor. The front is the wide side and faces local -Z; the angled side walls are plain party walls, and it carves nothing.
